(a) Get-Content reported E:\proj\agent\_comms\agent\_channel.py did not exist. E:\proj contained agent_comms, whose README and trial metadata confirmed the mapping. I used E:\proj\agent_comms\trials\2026-10-06-trial5-copilot_agent_channel with E:\proj\agent_comms\agent_channel.py.
(b) exec_command yielded a session after about 10 seconds; the Python process continued. I polled it within the turn. No hard process timeout is exposed. recv used --block-seconds 45 and has not returned waiting yet.
(c) Python reads/selftest needed no escalation. Sending required sandbox escalation because the channel is outside my writable roots; automatic approval review allowed it. I cannot see approval UI clicks. No further owner message arrived.
